title: Frozen Banana Piña Colada
description: Pineapple, coconut, and white rum blended with frozen banana for a creamy, frosty piña colada.
ingredients: ½ ripe banana, peeled, sliced, and frozen
1½ fluid ounces sweetened cream of coconut
steps: Add the frozen banana, frozen pineapple, rum, pineapple juice, cream of coconut, and ice to a blender.
Blend until smooth. If the blender stalls, add a splash of pineapple juice and blend again.
Pour into a chilled glass and garnish with the pineapple wedge, if using.
imageAlt: Creamy frozen piña colada with a pineapple garnish and sliced banana on red gingham
